CustomField.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL(Employee__r.Employment_Type__c , "Full Time"), Total_Hours__c >= IF(ISBLANK(Start_Date__c) || ISBLANK(End_Date__c) || (End_Date__c - Start_Date__c + 1) <= 7, 40, ROUND((End_Date__c - Start_Date__c + 1) * (5 / 7), 0) * 8), IF( ISPICKVAL(Employee__r.Employment_Type__c, "Part Time"), Total_Hours__c >= IF(ISBLANK(Start_Date__c) || ISBLANK(End_Date__c) || (End_Date__c - Start_Date__c + 1) <= 7, 20, ROUND((End_Date__c - Start_Date__c + 1) * (5 / 7), 0) * 4), IF( ISPICKVAL(Employee__r.Employment_Type__c, "Internship"), Total_Hours__c >= IF(ISBLANK(Start_Date__c) || ISBLANK(End_Date__c) || (End_Date__c - Start_Date__c + 1) <= 7, 10, ROUND((End_Date__c - Start_Date__c + 1) * (5 / 7), 0) * 2), FALSE ) ) )
CustomField.label: Met Weekly Hours
